{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace RateLimiter

inductive Request where
  | mk (at : Nat) (amount : Nat)

inductive Input where
  | mk (capacity : Nat) (period : Nat) (rate : Nat) (requests : List Request)

inductive Output where
  | mk (accepted : List Bool) (balances : List Nat) (denominator : Nat)

def valid (inp : Input) : Prop :=
  match inp with
  | Input.mk cap per rate reqs =>
    per > 0 ∧
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, r.at ≥ 0) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, r.amount ≥ 0) ∧
    (∀ i, i + 1 < reqs.length → reqs[i]!.at ≤ reqs[i+1]!.at)
  end

def solve (inp : Input) : Output :=
  match inp with
  | Input.mk cap per rate reqs =>
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (tokens : Nat) (acc : List Bool) (bal : List Nat) : Output :=
      if i < reqs.length then
        let r := reqs[i]!
        let prevTime := if i = 0 then 0 else reqs[i-1]!.at
        let dt := r.at - prevTime
        let refill := dt * rate
        let newTokens := min (tokens + refill) cap
        let accepted := newTokens ≥ r.amount
        let newBal := if accepted then (newTokens - r.amount) * per else newTokens * per
        loop (i + 1) (if accepted then newTokens - r.amount else newTokens) (acc ++ [accepted]) (bal ++ [newBal])
      else
        Output.mk acc bal per
    loop 0 cap [] []
  end

def denom (out : Output) : Nat :=
  match out with
  | Output.mk _ _ d => d
  end

def accepted (out : Output) : List Bool :=
  match out with
  | Output.mk a _ _ => a
  end

def balances (out : Output) : List Nat :=
  match out with
  | Output.mk _ b _ => b
  end

theorem thm_denominator (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  denom (solve inp) = (match inp with | Input.mk _ per _ _ => per end) := by sorry

theorem thm_accepted_length (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  (accepted (solve inp)).length = (match inp with | Input.mk _ _ _ reqs => reqs end).length := by sorry

theorem thm_balances_length (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  (balances (solve inp)).length = (match inp with | Input.mk _ _ _ reqs => reqs end).length := by sorry

theorem thm_non_vacuity :
  ∃ (inp : Input), valid inp ∧
    (∃ (i : Nat), i < (match inp with | Input.mk _ _ _ reqs => reqs end).length ∧
      (accepted (solve inp))[i]! = true) ∧
    (∃ (j : Nat), j < (match inp with | Input.mk _ _ _ reqs => reqs end).length ∧
      (accepted (solve inp))[j]! = false) := by sorry

end RateLimiter",
